work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. LIV 17710 follows prior dating 17703–17707; synopsis 17712–17715, two-cardinal addressee 17717–17720 and self-protocol 17722–17725 introduce one continuous deputation. Full dating starts 17746 and continues 17753–17754 across retained historical notes 17748–17749 and volume running footer 17750, then short date 17756. End refined from 17759 to 17756 because Supplicatio 17759 is the following LV 17762 act’s marginal label. No separate inserted instrument or reversed body column found.
